A **single click**"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" immediately restarts the `dsh web` process — the page disconnects for ~15–20 seconds, then you refr"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"esh and everything is back (sessions are persisted on disk and recover automatically). The button is"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" **persistent**: it survives the restart it triggers."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Windows-specific: the restart launches `dsh web` through an independent hidden PowerShell process,"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" so the script keeps running after the harness process is killed."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Single-click restart — no confirmation step, no double-click dance.
- Persistent: survives the DSH"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" restart it triggers (installed as a bundle-layer plugin, not a dynamic session plugin).
- Small foo"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"tprint: sits beside the Settings trigger in the sidebar footer; icon-only in the 56px rail, icon + l"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"abel in the wide sidebar.
- In-flight feedback: the button turns red and shows "重启中…" → "已触发" while "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"the request is being processed.
- Re-entry guard: a second click while a restart is already in fligh"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"t is rejected.
- Online status dot: the button also shows DSH liveness — a green dot polls `GET /dsh"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"-health` every 5s (red when the harness is unreachable/restarting)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### From GitHub (this repo)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web` once so the bundle layer loads."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Manual (edit profile files)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. Add the dependency:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"2. Add the plugin row (this repo ships its own `cordis.patch.yml` — either merge its row into your p"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"rofile's `cordis.patch.yml`, or install via the `dsh plugin` command above which does it for you):"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"3. `pnpm install` in the profile directory, then restart `dsh web`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Layer | File | What it does |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers an exact `POST /restart-dsh` route on the webServer; launches th"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e restart script as an independent hidden PowerShell under `danger-full-access` sandbox policy |
| C"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"lient | `lib/client.js` | Registers the sidebar footer button (slot `sidebar.footer.action`); single"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" click `fetch`es `POST /restart-dsh`; polls `GET /dsh-health` every 5s for the status dot |
| Bundle"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" | `cordis.patch.yml` | The loader row that mounts both halves |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The host routes return **before** the restart happens (~1s host timer + 3s inner sleep), giving the "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"browser time to render the "restarting" state before the page drops."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Why not `ctx.timeout` in the route handler"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`ctx.timeout` is a Cordis mixin backed by `ctx.effect()`, which is scoped to the Cordis **fiber** li"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"fecycle. A `webServer` route handler runs as a plain Node HTTP callback — outside any fiber — so `ct"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"x.effect`-registered timers are silently dropped and the restart never fires. This plugin uses Node'"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"s native `setTimeout` in the handler instead."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` (web profile).
- The restart script path (`D:\1\dsh-web-host.ps1`) i"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"s hard-coded for this author's machine — **fork and adjust it** (or replace the command in `lib/inde"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"x.js`) for your own environment. Contributions to make this configurable are welcome."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The client bundle is hand-written in the exact wire format (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, fact"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ory })`), so no build step is required:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
